title: HCG variable-cost surface inventory
important: Statuses describe THIS BRANCH once its provisional SQL is applied and it is deployed. Nothing here is deployed: production today has none of these controls (not even 056).

statusKey.ENFORCED: HCG code refuses or terminates the spend before it becomes unbounded, atomically, fail-closed, tested
statusKey.PARTIAL: enforced on some paths or for some failure modes; the gap is named
statusKey.INDIRECTLY_BOUNDED: not metered itself, but bounded by another enforced control

surfaces.cost: Twilio inbound minutes on the HCG number, billed for the whole call (incl. <Dial><Client>)
controls: 056 admit_call (concurrency/burst/flood/loop/£ ceilings)
fc_authorize_call reservation before any billable verb, <Reject> otherwise
lease renewal + REST hang-up at lease end
<Dial timeLimit> backstop sized so consumed + Σ live worst cases ≤ authorisation
global breaker / kill switch
surfaces.residual: Calls that arrive while HCG is unreachable (~1 started minute each, provider-side only). Termination latency ≤ sweep interval + provider latency, covered by the 60 s termination grace in each reservation; any excess is committed as overrun_gbp, never hidden.

surfaces.cost: <Dial><Client> minutes (billed £0 today; priced at list $0.004/min in every limit)
controls: same reservation as the inbound leg (connected rate = inbound + app leg)

surfaces.cost: Inbound minutes + Polly for calls to an HCG number with no household
controls: fc_authorize_call (unattributed) — global £/day cap, 120 s backstop, breaker
whole 30-min monitoring window reserved before the stream starts
stream attach refused unless the reservation covers monitoring (fail-closed)
056 monitoring gate + 30-min cap
only streams attached to a containment-authorised reservation transcribe
056 rate-anomaly guard
surfaces.residual: Bounded in MINUTES, not £: an OpenAI price change is invisible until the invoice (estimates reconciled only when actual costs are recorded via fc_record_actual — no OpenAI per-call cost source exists). /media-stream itself is still unauthenticated on this base (fixed on security/voice-surface-p0).

surfaces.trigger: POST /process (public route, unreachable from Twilio today)
controls: Twilio signature required
fc_authorize_spend('ai') per CallSid, fail-closed
surfaces.residual: The route itself still answers unauthenticated requests with TwiML (no cost). Its <Dial> has no timeLimit if /process is ever re-enabled — re-enabling requires adding containment there.

surfaces.cost: Twilio Polly characters (greeting, apology, red-line message)
controls: only executed inside an authorised call; call_fixed_fee_gbp in every reservation
surfaces.residual: Charged per call as a fixed fee inside the reservation; no separate meter.

surfaces.trigger: risk warnings, red-line, 30-min limit notice, safety-stop notice (live monitoring)
controls: fc_authorize_spend('sms') on EVERY send incl. the former null-period and no-household bypasses; fail-closed; idempotent per (household, recipient, body, minute)
056 SMS counts
surfaces.residual: Multi-segment messages are authorised as 1 unit (current messages are single-segment); geo-permissions are a provider setting.

surfaces.cost: Twilio number purchase + first month rental
surfaces.trigger: ensureTwilioNumberProvisioned (Stripe/RevenueCat webhooks, checkout reconcile, admin, invite redemption)
controls: fc_authorize_spend('number_purchase'): company-wide 10/24 h cap + breaker/kill switch; fail-closed; default for the real Twilio client
surfaces.residual: A purchase made directly with the Twilio master credentials (outside this code) bypasses it — provider-side restricted keys needed.

controls: number lifecycle release jobs (other workstreams)
economic policy deducts it from the variable envelope
surfaces.residual: Fixed monthly cost, not a usage cost; bounded by number count (purchase cap) and lifecycle release.

surfaces.cost: Twilio REST update + a few seconds of Polly before hang-up
controls: inside an authorised call
surfaces.residual: A few seconds of Polly inside an already-authorised call.

surfaces.cost: Twilio REST call fetches by the sweeper
controls: free API reads; throttled to one per call per 20 s
surfaces.residual: Twilio API rate limits, not money.

surfaces.trigger: sendCriticalAlert from many paths incl. unauthenticated ones
controls: per-type 30-min in-process rate limit
containment event de-duplication (5 min per rule/household)
surfaces.residual: Per-process limiter resets on restart; Resend plan limits unknown to HCG.

surfaces.cost: Confirmation / reset emails via Supabase's mailer
controls: Supabase's own rate limits only
surfaces.residual: Whether this costs HCG anything depends on the SMTP provider configured in Supabase (not in the repo). No app-level rate limit. Out of this workstream (security/fraud).

surfaces.cost: Calls placed by a (modified) mobile client via the Voice SDK outgoing grant to the TwiML App
controls: none in this branch
surfaces.residual: The TwiML App's Voice URL is configured in the Twilio console (unverified). If it points at /voice, containment applies; if elsewhere or unset, unknown. Needs provider confirmation (security workstream).

surfaces.cost: Up to 3× OpenAI requests on transient errors (SDK default maxRetries=2)
controls: transcription bounded in minutes per authorised stream; classifier authorised once per CallSid
surfaces.residual: Retries multiply OpenAI requests within an authorised stream; £ per request not observable by HCG.

surfaces.cost: Anything the Twilio master auth token can do (calls, numbers, geo permissions)
controls: none possible in application code
surfaces.residual: Provider-side only: restricted API keys, subaccounts, prepaid balance with auto-recharge off (decision), usage triggers (notify only).

surfaces.cost: ~1 started minute per call that arrives while HCG can't answer
controls: none in HCG code
surfaces.residual: Provider-side: a voice fallback URL returning static <Reject> (unbilled).
